title: ConnectWise Credential Compromise Leads to M365 Access
excerpt: Researchers reveal an active campaign where hackers used a compromised ConnectWise credential to access 173 Microsoft 365 tenants.
body_html:
Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered an active threat campaign involving the misuse of a compromised Microsoft 365 credential. The credential belongs to ConnectWise Cloud Backup, previously known as SkyKick, which is a cloud-based backup and recovery solution designed for managed service providers.

According to the findings, unknown attackers leveraged this compromised access to gain unauthorized entry into the Microsoft 365 environments of 173 different tenants. The campaign highlights ongoing risks associated with third-party service credentials and cloud infrastructure security.
